design_source.title: Talent Signal V1 完整产品与系统设计｜目标驱动智能 CRM（iOS + Backend + Claude Agent SDK）

repository.preservation_note: The starting worktree was dirty. Existing user-owned changes were preserved; this artifact freezes the listed product-source scope and evidence rather than claiming a clean commit.

scenario.persona: independent recruiter managing several live executive searches
scenario.starting_state: a synthetic Signal has changed the evidence attached to one live Pursuit
scenario.task: capture the Signal, resolve identity, inspect exact evidence, review one revision-checked internal Proposal, apply it once, and read canonical progress back from Today without an external effect
scenario.success_condition: the recruiter can identify the Pursuit outcome, blocking gap, evidence freshness, owner, proposed internal action, and durable review result; failure, stale, deletion, retry, interruption, and response-loss states remain truthful and recoverable

scores.interpretation: These deterministic acceptance ledgers are implementation evidence, not substitutes for the independent specialist reviews in this panel.

ios_full_suite.allowed_skip: CandidateSignalUITests/testLocalhostSyncSuccess(); legacy opt-in path replaced by dynamic-port canonical journeys in the same suite

ios_small_device.simulator: iPhone SE (3rd generation), 375x667, iOS 26.5, dark mode, AX5

agent.deterministic_evaluator: 30/30 passed across six cases; zero external effects

frozen_visual_evidence.state: Today in dark mode at AX5

forbidden: candidate ranking, fit, personality, protected-trait, or acceptance-probability inference
authority_boundary.human_gate: A generated Proposal has no execution authority. Canonical internal apply requires an explicit human decision, revision check, idempotency key, durable receipt, and readback.

known_missing_proof: Manual VoiceOver traversal by a human on the complete critical journey.
Physical-device Action Button and system-capture proof.
Five credentialed live Claude Agent SDK trials against the frozen evaluator; no credential or model was available, so live status is missing proof.
Production authentication, retention/deletion operations, regional data controls, provider reconciliation, and cross-tenant adversarial testing.
Design-partner recruiter field comparison and any authorized candidate-side experience study.
Real candidate data was intentionally excluded and must not be introduced to close this panel.
review_constraints: Review this exact artifact and its hashed evidence; prior baseline reviews are context, not an anchor.
Inspect current frozen source where a claim depends on behavior not fully visible in a screenshot.
Do not invent field, production, real-device, candidate, credentialed-model, or manual accessibility evidence.
Do not average safety, state-integrity, or accessibility vetoes into visual polish.
A missing external proof may constrain a release claim without negating directly proven local behavior.
No product-code edits are allowed during this panel.
expected_veto_state: none; any reviewer-discovered active veto reopens implementation and requires a newly frozen artifact
falsifiers: A UI success state can appear without a canonical revisioned write and readback.
A retry, duplicate, stale request, response loss, interruption, relaunch, or source deletion creates a duplicate or false success.
Identity or workspace scope can be inferred, crossed, or silently rebound.
Generated content is presented as evidence or can execute an external effect.
A critical control or recovery path is unreachable at 375x667, dark mode, or AX5.
The product ranks a person or makes a candidate-quality, fit, personality, protected-trait, or acceptance-probability claim.
